scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix fronted
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd fronted && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix fronted
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && npm run start" "cd fronted && npm run start"
